title: Bug:  [dhcp_relay] agent_relay_mode value set is inconsistent across YANG schema, dhcp_relay CLI, and dhcp4relay daemon
author: Xichen96
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

 ## Summary
 
 The `agent_relay_mode` field of the `DHCPV4_RELAY` table is declared
 with one set of enum values in the YANG schema, accepted with a
 different set by the `dhcp_relay` CLI, and honored with yet another
 set by the `dhcp4relay` daemon. Filing this for the dhcp_relay /
 sonic-dhcpv4-relay owners to track and fix; I hit it as a downstream
 side-effect while triaging an unrelated test failure and don't have
 the area expertise to drive the cleanup.
 
 ## Symptom (where I tripped over it)
 
 Running `tests/dhcp_relay/test_dhcpv4_relay.py::test_dhcp_relay_agent_mode`
 on a 720dt testbed produces a libyang validation error during the
 post-test config snapshot / teardown phase:
 

libyang[0]: Invalid value "append" in "agent_relay_mode" element.

 
 The test itself parametrizes `agent_relay_mode` with `discard`,
 `replace`, `append` (the values the CLI accepts and the daemon
 honors), but the YANG typedef does not list any of those — it lists
 `forward_and_append`, `forward_and_replace`, `forward_untouched`,
 `discard`. So writing the CLI's value into CONFIG_DB makes the next
 `config save` / sonic-cfggen pass fail YANG validation.
 
 I attempted a minimal additive fix in
 sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#26886 (now closed — see "Why I'm not
 fixing this myself" below).
 
 ## Where each layer stands today
 
 | Layer | File | Accepted / honored values |
 |---|---|---|
 | CLI plugin | `sonic-buildimage/dockers/docker-dhcp-relay/cli/config/plugins/dhcp_relay.py` | `click.Choice(["discard", "append", "replace"])` (×4) |
 | Daemon | `sonic-dhcp-relay/dhcp4relay/src/dhcp4relay.cpp` ~L593-610 | hard-coded `strcmp` against `"append"` and `"replace"`; **everything else** (incl. `"discard"`, the `forward_*` strings, an unset/empty field, or any typo) falls through to the else-branch and the packet is dropped |
 | YANG schema | `sonic-buildimage/src/sonic-yang-models/yang-templates/sonic-types.yang.j2` typedef `relay-agent-mode` | `forward_and_append`, `forward_and_replace`, `forward_untouched`, `discard` (default `forward_untouched`) |
 | HLD doc | `SONiC/doc/DHCPv4_relay/DHCPv4-relay-agent-High-Level-Design.md` | uses the YANG (long-form) values throughout — typedef snippet, sample CONFIG_DB, CLI help, example commands, show output |
 | Test docstring | `sonic-mgmt/tests/dhcp_relay/test_dhcpv4_relay.py::test_dhcp_relay_agent_mode` | docstring lists long-form values; `@pytest.mark.parametrize` actually uses `discard`/`replace`/`append` |
 
 The schema-allowed set and the daemon-honored set are disjoint on the
 values that matter (`append`, `replace`).
 
 ## Important nuance: when `agent_relay_mode` is consulted at all
 
 The daemon consults `agent_relay_mode` **only for relay-of-relay
 traffic** — DHCP packets that already carry an Option 82 from another
 upstream relay agent. For ordinary client packets (no Option 82), the
 daemon always forwards and adds its own Option 82 regardless of
 `agent_relay_mode`.
 
 For relay-of-relay traffic specifically:
 
 | `agent_relay_mode` value | Daemon behaviour |
 |---|---|
 | `"append"` | Forward + append our own Option 82 |
 | `"replace"` | Strip existing Option 82, add our own, forward |
 | `"discard"` | Drop |
 | unset / `"forward_untouched"` / `"forward_and_append"` / `"forward_and_replace"` / typo | Drop (else-branch fall-through) |
 
 Two consequences worth flagging:
 
 1. The YANG default `forward_untouched` is misleading — the name
    implies "forward unchanged" but the daemon actually *drops* such
    packets. The daemon's true no-config behaviour falls into the
    *discard* branch.
 2. The three `forward_*` enums are dead values: nothing in the
    codebase ever sets them and the daemon never honored them.
 
 Source: [`dhcp4relay.cpp` ~L593-610](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-dhcp-relay/blob/master/dhcp4relay/src/dhcp4relay.cpp#L593-L610).
 
 ## Suggested fix (for the dhcp_relay owners)
 
 Pick `discard` / `append` / `replace` as the single source of truth
 across YANG, CLI, daemon, HLD doc, and test docstring, and change the
 YANG default to `discard` to match the daemon's actual no-config
 behaviour. Org-wide grep shows zero production references to the
 `forward_*` values (no daemon, CLI, orchagent, dbmigrator,
 golden-config, ansible playbook, or YAML fixture sets them) — they
 exist only in the YANG typedef itself, the YANG sample CONFIG_DB,
 the HLD doc, and the test docstring above. So removing them from the
 typedef is safe.
 
 cc / FYI: dhcpv4-relay maintainers (please re-assign as needed).

### Steps to Reproduce

On any switch running an image with the new SONiC DHCPv4 relay (has_sonic_dhcpv4_relay=true):

 # 1. Pick any VLAN that has a DHCPV4_RELAY entry (or create one).
 VLAN=Vlan1000
 DHCP_SERVER=192.168.20.100
 
 # 2. Use the dhcp_relay CLI to set agent_relay_mode to a value the CLI accepts.
 sudo config dhcp_relay ipv4 helper add ${VLAN} ${DHCP_SERVER}
 sudo config dhcp_relay ipv4 helper update ${VLAN} --agent-relay-mode append
 
 # 3. Confirm the value landed in CONFIG_DB.
 sonic-db-cli CONFIG_DB HGET "DHCPV4_RELAY|${VLAN}" agent_relay_mode
 # -> "append"
 
 # 4. Trigger any YANG validation pass.
 sudo config save -y
 #   - or -
 sudo config reload -y
 #   - or -
 sonic-cfggen -d -y /etc/sonic/init_cfg.json -t /usr/share/sonic/templates/...

Equivalent reproducer via the existing test:

 cd sonic-mgmt
 ./run_tests.sh -n <testbed-name> -c "dhcp_relay/test_dhcpv4_relay.py::test_dhcp_relay_agent_mode"
 # Observe libyang error during the post-test config snapshot / teardown phase.


### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Actual behavior

The YANG schema rejects the CLI's value, so step 4 above (or the post-test config snapshot) fails with:

 libyang[0]: Invalid value "append" in "agent_relay_mode" element.

The same error occurs for replace. Symmetrically, the schema accepts forward_and_append, forward_and_replace, and forward_untouched, but the daemon does not honor any of them — they all silently fall into the discard else-branch (dhcp4relay.cpp ~L593-610), so even setting one of those "valid" values does not produce the behaviour its name suggests.

In a sonic-mgmt test context this surfaces as a teardown-time YANG validation failure (observed in test_dhcp_relay_agent_mode and adjacent tests on 720dt testbeds), with PRs #24043 / #24044 needing additional cleanup workarounds purely to keep the YANG validator happy.

Expected behavior

YANG should accept exactly the values the CLI emits and the daemon implements:

 - discard — drop relay-of-relay packets (also the daemon's actual no-config default, so this should be the YANG default as well).
 - append — forward + append our own Option
  82.
 - replace — strip existing Option 82, add ours, forward.

config save, config reload, and sonic-cfggen should all complete without libyang errors after any CLI-driven --agent-relay-mode change. The legacy forward_and_append / forward_and_replace / forward_untouched strings should either be removed or, at minimum, documented as deprecated aliases that map to the daemon-honored values (preferably the former — they
are dead values today, with zero references in any production code path across the sonic-net org).

linkedPullRequests.title: [dhcp_relay] Fix agent_relay_mode: align YANG and CLI with ISC behavior
linkedPullRequests.author: ashutosh-agrawal
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

The YANG typedef `relay-agent-mode` used long-form ISC internal enum names
(`forward_and_append`, `forward_and_replace`, `forward_untouched`, `discard`)
while the CLI accepted short-form ISC CLI aliases (`append`, `replace`, `discard`).
This caused `config save` / `config reload` to fail with:

```
libyang[0]: Invalid value "append" in "agent_relay_mode" element.
```

Additionally, the fourth ISC mode (`forward` / forward untouched) was missing
from the CLI entirely, with no way to configure pass-through behavior.

Fixes sonic-net/sonic-mgmt#24052.
Depends on sonic-net/sonic-dhcp-relay#106 (daemon fix, submodule bump to follow once that merges).

#### How I did it

- `sonic-types.yang.j2`: rename `relay-agent-mode` typedef enums to short-form (`append`, `replace`, `forward`, `discard`) — strict 1:1 mapping from long-form ISC names; `discard` remains the default (SONiC's ISC template always passed `-m discard` explicitly, preserving existing behavior)
- `sonic-dhcpv4-relay.yang`: update `agent_relay_mode` leaf default to `discard`
- `dhcp_relay.py`: add `forward` to `click.Choice` in all four `--agent-relay-mode` declarations
- CLI plugin tests: add `forward` to the `agent_relay_modes` test list
- YANG model tests: add fixtures for all four valid values

#### How to verify it

```
sudo config dhcp_relay ipv4 helper update Vlan1000 --agent-relay-mode append
sudo config save -y
# No libyang validation error
```

#### Which release branch to backport

None

#### Description for the changelog

Fix `agent_relay_mode` YANG enum names: rename long-form ISC internal names to short-form CLI aliases (`append`, `replace`, `forward`, `discard`), add missing `forward` mode to CLI, and set default to `discard` (preserving existing SONiC behavior).

#### Link to config_db schema for YANG module changes

No external schema link needed; changes are self-contained in `sonic-types.yang.j2` and `sonic-dhcpv4-relay.yang`.

#### Supported devices and platforms

All platforms using `sonic-dhcp-relay`.

linkedPullRequests.title: [dhcp4relay] Fix agent_relay_mode: add forward mode, align with ISC behavior
linkedPullRequests.author: ashutosh-agrawal
linkedPullRequests.body:
#### Why I did it

The daemon only handled `append` and `replace` explicitly in `from_client()`.
All other values — including `forward_untouched` (the YANG default), `discard`,
and any unrecognized string — fell to an else-branch that silently dropped the
packet. This meant:

- `forward_untouched` dropped packets instead of forwarding them unchanged,
  despite the YANG default being set to that value.
- `discard` worked only by accident via the else fallthrough.
- There was no way to configure pass-through (forward untouched) behavior,
  unlike ISC dhcrelay which supports `-m forward`.

This is the daemon-side fix for sonic-net/sonic-mgmt#24052.

#### How I did it

Add `forward` as an explicit mode in `from_client()` that passes relay-of-relay
packets through without modifying Option 82. Make `discard` explicit in the
else branch. Update the comment to document all four modes: `append`, `replace`,
`forward`, `discard`.

Also add unit tests for all four relay-of-relay modes. Previously none of
the `agent_relay_mode` code paths in `from_client()` had test coverage.

#### How to verify it

```
cd dhcp4relay && make test
```

New tests added:
- `from_client_relay_of_relay_append`  — `send_udp` called, option appended
- `from_client_relay_of_relay_replace` — `send_udp` called, option replaced
- `from_client_relay_of_relay_forward` — `send_udp` called, packet unchanged
- `from_client_relay_of_relay_discard` — `send_udp` NOT called

linkedPullRequests.title: [dhcp_relay] Fix agent_relay_mode: align test docstring with short-form enum values
linkedPullRequests.author: ashutosh-agrawal
linkedPullRequests.body:
## Description

Fix `test_dhcp_relay_agent_mode` docstring to use the canonical short-form enum values (`discard`, `replace`, `append`) instead of the old long-form names that were never valid in the YANG schema or daemon.

The parametrize values and CONFIG_DB writes in this test were already using the correct short-form names; only the docstring listed the wrong old names (`forward_untouched`, `forward_and_replace`, `forward_and_append`).

## Related issue

Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-mgmt/issues/24052

## Motivation and Context

A three-way inconsistency existed across the SONiC DHCPv4 relay stack:

| Layer | Old values | New (canonical) values |
|---|---|---|
| YANG (`sonic-types.yang`) | `forward_and_append`, `forward_and_replace`, `forward_untouched`, `discard` | `append`, `replace`, `forward`, `discard` |
| CLI (`dhcp_relay.py`) | `discard`, `append`, `replace` | `discard`, `append`, `replace`, `forward` |
| Daemon (`dhcp4relay.cpp`) | `append`, `replace`, (implicit discard) | `append`, `replace`, `forward`, `discard` |

The YANG schema was rejecting the CLI/daemon values, causing `libyang[0]: Invalid value "append" in "agent_relay_mode" element.`

The coordinated fix across the stack:
- **sonic-dhcp-relay** – add explicit `forward` and `discard` cases in `dhcp4relay.cpp`; add unit tests
- **sonic-buildimage** – rename YANG enum values to short-form; add `forward` to CLI; sync submodule
- **SONiC (HLD)** – update design doc to reflect new values and `replace` default

This PR aligns the sonic-mgmt test docstring with those changes.

## Type of change

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Documentation update

## Test

`tests/dhcp_relay/test_dhcpv4_relay.py::test_dhcp_relay_agent_mode` — docstring-only change; no functional test logic modified.
